name: vSphere Build Node
description: VMware Hyper-V VM - 4 vCPU build/CI agent. Runs on Intel Xeon Gold 6254 host in on-premises datacenter. Hosts Azure DevOps on-premises build agents.

specifications.storage_type: VMware Virtual Disk (local or SAN datastore)
specifications.notes: VM has 4 vCPUs out of 18 physical cores. Effective VM TDP share = 200W × (4/18) ≈ 44.4W. Memory is estimated at 16GB (typical CI agent allocation) — confirm via vCenter if needed.

embodied_carbon.vm_share_notes: Embodied carbon allocated proportionally: physical CPU × (4 vCPU / 18 physical cores).

cpu.source: Boavizta estimate for Intel Xeon Gold 6254 (Cascade Lake 14nm, ~80,000 gCO2e total) × 4/18 vCPU share
cpu.notes: Intel Xeon Gold 6254 — 18-core, manufactured at Intel 14nm fabs (Cascade Lake)

infrastructure_share.source: Proportional share of motherboard, chassis, PSU, NIC, cooling (4/18 of host)

embodied_carbon.allocation_method: Proportional vCPU share of physical host (4/18 cores)

lifespan.notes: Aligned with physical host refresh cycle

pue.source: Uptime Institute 2021 average for enterprise data centers
pue.notes: Replace with actual on-premises datacenter PUE if known
